title: Productivity of jail inmates during 1995

columns.name: Productivity of Gross value (Rs. in lakhs)
header: Productivity of Gross value (Rs. in lakhs)

notes: The above data speaks by itself on the productivity in the jail premises earned by the inmates
in the various trades in which they were engaged. It is needless to mention that the gainful work put
up by the jail population shall not only provide corrective approach to the mental faculty of the
offender but also goes a long way for him to realise and develop responsive and respectful attitudes.
The prisoners not only are expected to develop self confidence and esteem out of the valuable labour
put in by them, but these activities also expose them to earn a honourable living in life.
